_comment: ESP-FLY indoor layout: 5 x 6 m room. Three nodes low in floor corners, ONE NODE ON THE CEILING - that fourth node out of the plane is what makes altitude observable (coplanar nodes cannot measure z; see docs/3d-sensing.md). Measure every position, including z, with a laser meter. rssi0 = median RSSI at 1 m (run calibrate.py).
_radar: Active FMCW radar (radar_acquire.py -> /api/radar): radar_origin = horn position in the same frame as the nodes, boresight along +x; sigma_r from range interpolation (~0.1-0.2 m), sigma_az from beam centroiding (2.5 deg measured in radar_twin).
